title: The High tier is empty because the brief's two rules intersect in a 1.4-point window
detail: The brief defines a high-confidence pick as better than 70% and also requires the fair price to be no shorter than -250. A -250 price is 71.43%, so only selections between 70.00% and 71.43% can satisfy both rules. No selection originated on this card lands in that window, so zero High picks are published rather than one being manufactured to fill the tier.

title: Three selections clear 70% but are excluded by the -250 floor
detail: Philadelphia (78.9%, fair -375) and Edmonton (75.4%, fair -306) both exceed 70% on our numbers, but their fair prices are shorter than -250, which the brief excludes, so they are published at medium tier. No selection landed between 70.00% and 71.43%, the only span that could satisfy both of the brief's rules.

title: Injury fields are blank everywhere
detail: No official injury, suspension or availability report was read for any of the 13 priced matches (NBA, NHL, MLB, Cork GAA, ATP). Nothing has been inferred or filled in. Every injury column is empty by design.

title: Ten of the fifteen requested sports carry no priced selection
detail: Golf, Volleyball, Rugby Union, Cricket, Snooker, Darts, Greyhounds, Motor Racing, Handball and Rugby League are published as gaps with the exact blocking source on the sports pages and on the Flagged page. The five sports with prices are Basketball, Ice Hockey, Baseball, Gaelic Sports and Tennis.

title: Minnesota Wild at Seattle Kraken start time not read
detail: The official schedule's timing block for game 2026020179 was not reached before the read stopped, so the row carries a blank start rather than a guessed one.

detail: Both semi-finals are confirmed on the official ATP scores page, so the final pairing follows from them; the start time is not published there. The only time available was OLBG's listing (06:00), which is discovery and is not used as a fixture fact.

title: NBA season-leader block on the official games page is not citable
detail: The games page labels a Milwaukee player under Miami and a Charlotte player under Charlotte with mismatched club codes. Because the labels are internally inconsistent, no player-level statistic from that block is used in any write-up.

detail: 2360a617, 6a081cf6, aa4e9dbf, ccb6bde2, ebfbd966 and f7fa77fc publish pages without a matching data/<id>/ folder. Some store JSON as flat suffixed files or under datasets/, so this is a layout inconsistency, not proven data loss.
